description: Annapolis, Maryland – Delegate Nic Kipke has officially filed with the State Board of Elections to run for the Maryland State Senate representing District 31. This announcement follows the decision of Senator Bryan Simonaire not to seek reelection after two decades of service to the district. title: Nic Kipke and District 31 Republican Legislative Slate File for 2026 Election - Nic Kipke
